question.text: The operations of depositories in India are regulated under which legal framework?

answer.text: Depositories Act 1996, SEBI (D&P) Regulations 2018, Bye-Laws, Operating Instructions, and PMLA 2002
Companies Act 2013 and SEBI Act 1992 only
RBI Act and Banking Regulation Act only
Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act and SEBI Act only

explanation.text: The Logic: The legal framework comprises the Depositories Act 1996, SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations 2018, SEBI-approved Bye-Laws, Operating Instructions, and PMLA 2002. The Trap: Limiting the framework to the Companies Act and SEBI Act, or to RBI/SCRA, omits the core depository-specific instruments. Note: Reproduce the workbook's legal-framework list as stated; broader AML/KYC commentary is outside the cited page.
